headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.34
summary: The left and right nav bar stops being shifted around by the camera cutout. On a notched phone in landscape the rail used to grow horizontal padding and push its icon column inwards, clipping the icons; the bar now sits exactly where the layout puts it again.

items.text: With the nav bar on the left or right, a camera cutout on the same edge made the launcher grow the bar's padding, which pushed the whole icon column inwards and clipped it. The nav bar no longer takes part in cutout avoidance, so side and bottom bars keep their normal layout. Page content still keeps its distance from the camera.
